view: single full-body creature in a neutral three-quarter front view, centered, all appendages visible, 10-14% even padding
linework: opaque dark-charcoal contour with subtle thick-to-thin taper; heavier exterior contour and sparse thinner interior lines
color: two to four crisp flat local colors plus at most one accent; closed opaque shapes with no texture
shading: exactly one small hard-edged cel-shadow family covering roughly 10-18% of visible body area; tiny eye highlights only
background: perfectly uniform solid chroma-key color with no cast shadow, contact shadow, gradient, texture, reflection, or floor plane
avoid: depth of field or volumetric effects
